constraints_found.source: roxy: "SUSHI. way too hot out for anything warm. let's do it!!"
maya: "sushi yes. fancy sushi no. one dollar sign max, the trip fund is non-negotiable"
cyrus: "Sushi works for me. One rule, as always: I'm allergic to peanuts. Some rolls come with peanut sauce or crushed peanuts on top, so please check."

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian with proper vegetarian rolls, not just sides (strict diet, deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source: maya: "mina. you're vegetarian. rice and edamame is a side, not a lunch" / cyrus: "We need somewhere with proper vegetarian rolls, not just a side dish." / mina: "a few veggie rolls to choose from would be really nice."

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance (costs a star, not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source: roxy: "ok i'm so ready. oh, small thing, nothing creamy in mine pls. dairy and i don't get along"

venue_analysis.downtown_koi_counter: $, whole meat-free roll section, no peanuts, no milk/cream/cream cheese. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_analysis.downtown_kumo_bar: Peanuts on rolls and peanut dipping sauce. Deal-breaker for Cyrus.
venue_analysis.downtown_silver_reed: Fish in every roll, nothing vegetarian. Deal-breaker for Mina.
venue_analysis.downtown_hinoki_table: Cream cheese and mayo on nearly everything, veggie rolls included. Dairy miss for Roxy: 2 stars.
venue_analysis.downtown_cedar_line: $$, one tier over budget. Otherwise meets everything: 2 stars.

notes: Fair and solvable. Every distractor fails on exactly one constraint, which reads clearly in the reviews. Mina's need comes out well: she plays it down and the others name it, so you have to read past what she says she wants. Roxy's dairy line is clear, and the milkshake follow-up backs it up. Cyrus spelling out the cream-cheese risk makes the dairy check fairly obvious, though. Both Hinoki Table and Cedar Line come out at 2 stars, so there are two near-miss options, which is fine. Nothing contradictory.
